reportedIssues: The discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' card shows '-0%', which is a meaningless value (zero percent off) and looks like a data or formatting bug.

The category filter row ('Healthy' chip) and the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') are cut off at the right screen edge with no visible scroll indicator or fade-out, so it is not obvious that more content is available horizontally.
The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated mid-word with no ellipsis styling consistency and limited visible context in the card.

The heart/favorite icons on the 'Popular right now' cards sit on varied image backgrounds; the dark circular background on the ramen card is fine, but contrast of the white outline icon may be insufficient on lighter images.
